```{r}
# extra functions
select_unique <- function(input, ...){
  input %>% 
    select(...) %>% 
    unique() %>% 
    droplevels()
}
filter_unique <- function(input, ...){
  input %>% 
    filter(...) %>% 
    unique() %>% 
    droplevels()
}

plot_upset <- function(df, vars, n_intersections = 10, Compare = "Condition", labels = "abs", lab.size = 2){
  # get an upset plot of the number of different vars
  ## prepare data
  df[, "Compare"] <- df[, Compare]
  df_distinct <- df %>%
    distinct(Compare, {{ vars }}, .keep_all= FALSE)
  df_distinct_total <-  df_distinct %>% pull({{ vars }}) %>%  n_distinct()
  ## plot
  upset_table <-   df_distinct %>%
    group_by({{ vars }}) %>%
    summarize(Compare = list(as.character(Compare)), .groups = "drop") 
  p_upset <- upset_table %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=Compare)) +
    geom_bar(fill ="#39568CFF") +
    # geom_text(stat = "count", aes(label = after_stat(count)), vjust = -0.2, size = 2) +
    scale_x_upset(n_intersections = n_intersections) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 8)+
    theme(plot.margin = unit(c(0.2,0.2,0.2,2.2), "cm")) +
    theme_combmatrix(
      combmatrix.panel.point.color.fill = "#39568CFF",
      combmatrix.panel.line.size = 0,
      combmatrix.label.make_space = FALSE) +
    labs(caption = paste0("Total unique = ", df_distinct_total, "    Max. intersections shown = ", n_intersections))
  if(labels == "perc"){
    p_upset <- p_upset +
      geom_text(stat = "count", aes(label = after_stat(paste0(round(100*count/sum(count), 1), "%"))),
                vjust = -0.2, size = lab.size)
  }
  if(labels == "abs"){
    p_upset <- p_upset +
      geom_text(stat = "count", aes(label = after_stat(count)),
                vjust = -0.2, size = lab.size)
  }

  return(p_upset)
}


plot_upset_batch <- function(df, vars, n_intersections = 20, Compare = "Condition", labels = "abs", lab.size = 2){
  output <- 
    lapply(vars, function(x){
      df %>% 
        select_unique(var = x, Compare) %>% 
        plot_upset(., var, n_intersections = n_intersections, Compare = Compare,
                   labels = labels, lab.size = lab.size) +
        ggtitle(paste0(x, " overlap by ", Compare))
    })
  names(output) <- paste0(var_levels, "_by_", Compare)
  return(output)
}

write.csv_rawr <- function(input, folder = FolderResults){
  write.csv(input, file.path(folder,
                             paste0(params$Subset, "_", deparse(substitute(input)), ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
}

count_uniqueby <- function (df, vars, by, total = FALSE, sep = "_"){
  # count unique or distinct entries in variables grouped by
  require(dplyr)
  count_by <- df %>%
    group_by(across({{by}})) %>% 
    summarise(across({{vars}}, list(n = n_distinct),
                     .names = paste0("{fn}", sep, "{col}")), 
              .groups = "drop")
  if (total == TRUE) {
    count_total <- df %>% 
      mutate(across({{by}}, ~sub(.x, pattern = ".*", replacement = "Total"))) %>% 
      group_by(across({{by}})) %>% 
      summarise(across({{vars}}, list(n = n_distinct),
                       .names = paste0("{fn}", sep, "{col}")),
                .groups = "drop")
    count_by <- rbind(count_by, count_total)
  }
  return(count_by)
}

count_uniqueby_ip  <- function(input, var, by,  level = "Peptide"){
  # count number of samples and patients were Peptide or Protein (=level) were detected in group "by"
  # var = one single column, e.g. Patient or Sample
  # note: removed ProteinFirst, GeneFirst from the grouping,  because some Peptides assigned to difft ProteinFirst in the different processes
  if(level == "Peptide") {
    key_columns <-  c("Accession", "ProteinFirst",  "GeneFirst",  "OrganismFirst",  "Length", "Peptide", "Sequence")
  }
  if(level == "Protein") {
    key_columns <-  c("Accession", "ProteinFirst",  "GeneFirst",  "OrganismFirst")
  }
  input %>% 
    count_uniqueby(vars = {{var}},
                   by = c({{by}}, all_of(key_columns))) %>% 
    pivot_wider(id_cols = all_of(key_columns),
                names_from = {{by}}, values_from = starts_with("n_"), names_glue = "{.value}s.{.name}", values_fill = 0) %>% 
    arrange(pick(key_columns))
}
count_samples_patients  <- function(input, level){
  # summarizes pep_all counts per Patient, Sample_type, and Condition for Peptide or Protein (=level) 
  counts_total_samples <- count_uniqueby_ip(mutate(input, Condition = "Total") , 
                                            var = Sample, by = Condition, level)
  counts_total_patients <- count_uniqueby_ip(mutate(input, Condition = "Total") ,
                                             var = Patient, by = Condition, level)
  counts_patient <- count_uniqueby_ip(input, var = Sample, by = Patient, level)
  counts_type <- count_uniqueby_ip(input, var = Patient, by = Sample_type, level)
  counts_condition <- count_uniqueby_ip(input, var = Sample, by = Condition, level)
  # check that rows are in the same order
  if(level == "Peptide") {
    key_columns <-  c("Accession", "ProteinFirst",  "GeneFirst",  "OrganismFirst",  "Length", "Peptide", "Sequence")
  }
  if(level == "Protein") {
    key_columns <-  c("Accession", "ProteinFirst",  "GeneFirst",  "OrganismFirst")
  }
  key_info <- counts_condition[, key_columns] 
  if(all(key_info == counts_total_patients[, key_columns], na.rm = TRUE) &
     all(key_info == counts_total_samples[, key_columns], na.rm = TRUE) &
     all(key_info == counts_patient[, key_columns], na.rm = TRUE) &
     all(key_info == counts_type[, key_columns], na.rm = TRUE)){
    # if all the key columns are identical, merge counts
    output <- 
      cbind(
        key_info, 
        counts_total_samples   %>%  select(starts_with("n_")),
        counts_total_patients   %>%  select(starts_with("n_")),
        counts_type  %>%  select(starts_with("n_")),
        counts_patient  %>%  select(starts_with("n_")),
        counts_condition %>%  select(starts_with("n_"))
      ) 
  }else{
    stop("data in key_columns is not the same, check if they were ordered correctly")
  }
  return(output)
}



```


# Introduction

## Context

Below are shown the UpSet plots representing the overlap between the conditions evaluated. 

## Glosary:

* Peptides (e.g. in barplots): this includes possible peptidoforms (i.e. different PTMs); although the peptides are often detected only in one peptidoform.
* Sequences (e.g. in Venn plots): this refers to the stripped peptide sequence regardless of the possible PTMs.
* All peptides = all peptides detected
* Selected peptides = `r paste0(params$ShortPeptideLenghtMin," to ", params$ShortPeptideLenghtMax, " AAs")`

```{r echo=FALSE}

# load(file.path(params$FolderData, "pep_all_patients.rda"))
file_rda <- file.path( file.path(params$FolderData,paste0(suffix, "pep_all.rda")))


load(file_rda)

pep_all <-
  pep_all %>% 
  filter(Condition != "JY_QC") %>% 
  droplevels() %>% 
  mutate(ProteinFirst = gsub("Cont_|cont_", "", ProteinFirst)) %>% 
  mutate(Condition = fct_relabel(.f = Condition, .fun = ~ gsub("_DIA", "", .x))) %>% 
  separate_wider_delim(., cols = Condition , delim = "_", cols_remove = FALSE, 
                       names = c("Patient", "Sample_type")) %>% 
  mutate(Sample_type = factor(Sample_type, levels = c("tissue", "plasma", "PBMCs"))) %>%
  mutate(Sample = sub("_1$", "", Sample) ) %>% 
  relocate(Sample_type,.before = "Condition") 

write.csv(unique(pep_all[names(pep_all)[c(1:8)]]),
          file.path("1_documentation", paste0("extended_", params$AnnotationFile)),
          row.names = FALSE)
```

# summary counts for each peptide or protein per condition, patient, sample_type

- Filtered  = removed  accessions that were empty or had "Cont_" (contaminants)
- n_Samples.XXX = number of samples of a Patient or Patient_Sample_type where the peptide was found
- n_Patient.XXX = number of patients of Sample_type where the peptide was found
- in_Sample_type = logical, TRUE if found in Sample_Type




```{r}
pep_patient_biorep_summary <-
  pep_all  %>% 
  mutate(Area_imputed = is.na(Log2Area)) %>% 
  mutate(Log2Area = replace_na(Log2Area, 6.5)) %>% 
   group_by(Sample_type, Patient, Condition, BioReplicate, Accession, ProteinFirst,GeneFirst, OrganismFirst, 
           Peptide, Sequence, Length_range) %>% 
  summarise(n_Samples = n_distinct(Sample),
            Area_mean = mean(Area),
            Area_max = max(Area),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  ungroup() 



pep_patient_condition_summary <-
  pep_all  %>% 
  mutate(Area_imputed = is.na(Log2Area)) %>% 
  mutate(Log2Area = replace_na(Log2Area, 6.5)) %>% 
  group_by(Sample_type, Patient, Condition, BioReplicate, Accession, ProteinFirst,GeneFirst, OrganismFirst, 
           Peptide, Sequence, Length_range) %>% 
  summarise(n_Samples = n_distinct(Sample),
            Area_mean = mean(Area),
            Area_max = max(Area),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  ungroup() 
```

# All peptides - overlap between Conditions, per Sample_type {.tabset}

```{r echo=FALSE,  fig.height=3.0, fig.width=3.5, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='asis'}
for(j in 1:length(sampletypes)){
  cat("\n## ", sampletypes[j],"{.tabset} \n")
  up_list_j <-
     seq_all_condition %>% 
    filter_unique(Sample_type ==  sampletypes[j]) %>% 
    plot_upset_batch(vars = var_levels, Compare = "Condition")
  for (i in 1:length(var_levels)) {
    cat("\n### ", var_levels[i],"\n")
    up_list_j[i]  %>%  print()
    cat('\n\n')
  }
  cat('\n')
}
```
